observations: The map shows a multi-level dungeon with a river running from the northwest through the northern chambers and down the eastern side to exit at the southern cliff. Key uncertainties: (1) The exact connection between J3 (Trapped Fork) and surrounding rooms is somewhat ambiguous due to tunnel complexity in the western burial area. (2) The connection between rooms 11/12 and the Riven Hall (13) appears to be vertical (pit/overhang) based on the 'hanging' designation. (3) Room 6 connects to 8W through what appears to be a sealed door. (4) The secret door between 9 and 10 is marked with an S on the map. (5) The river waypoints are positioned to show where water crossings are possible between bank-adjacent rooms. (6) Room 14 and 15 are on the far (east) side of the river, accessible via river crossings at R3 or through room 8E.
